issues.label: Population Collapse
issues.summary: Fertility rates far below replacement — labor force shrinking, dependency ratios inverting, economic contraction looming

circuits.detail: Birth rates plummeting below 1.5 TFR — bonding and family formation incentives insufficient against economic headwinds
Family structures weakening — marriage rates declining, single-person households becoming dominant form
Labor force shrinking — critical sectors unable to fill positions, economic output declining per capita
Aging population overwhelming health and pension systems designed for younger demographics
Youth cohort shrinking — innovation, entrepreneurship, and risk-taking capacity declining with demographic aging
Rural regions depopulating fastest — entire communities disappearing within a generation

issues.label: Mass Migration Crisis
issues.summary: Climate displacement, conflict, and economic desperation driving unprecedented population movements across borders

circuits.detail: Migration flows exceeding institutional processing capacity — millions in transit without legal status
Refugee populations surging — 100+ million forcibly displaced, resettlement systems overwhelmed
Urban planning systems unable to absorb rapid population influx — housing, transit, and services failing
Intercultural empathy collapsing under volume pressure — nativist backlash intensifying
Income distribution destabilized — wage compression in receiving communities, remittance dependency in sending ones

issues.label: Aging Crisis
issues.summary: Dependency ratios inverting as populations age — healthcare, pension, and caregiving systems approaching insolvency

circuits.detail: Elder population growing faster than caregiving capacity — dementia, chronic disease, and long-term care demand exploding
Cardiovascular and chronic disease burden rising with aging population — healthcare costs spiraling
Workforce participation declining as retirement age cohorts grow and fewer young workers replace them
Educational systems failing to retrain older workers — skill obsolescence compounding demographic pressure
Family caregiving burden falling on smaller families — sandwich generation crushed between elder care and child-rearing
Pension systems underfunded — intergenerational wealth transfer becoming politically contentious

issues.label: Urbanization Overload
issues.summary: Megacities growing beyond infrastructure capacity — housing crisis, transit collapse, and service gaps accelerating

circuits.detail: Urban planning overwhelmed — construction, zoning, and service provision unable to keep pace with growth
Population density exceeding livability thresholds — crowding stress, pollution, and noise at crisis levels
Rural-to-urban migration hollowing out source communities while overloading destination cities
Commuting patterns dysfunctional — average transit times exceeding tolerance, productivity lost to transportation
Social cohesion declining in hyperdense environments — anomie, isolation, and intergroup tension rising
Housing costs creating extreme inequality — spatial sorting by income concentrating poverty and privilege

issues.label: Pandemic Demographic Shock

circuits.detail: Excess mortality overwhelming vital statistics — life expectancy dropping for first time in decades
Birth rates dropping during and after pandemic — conception rates suppressed by economic and psychological shock
Census and vital registration systems scrambling to measure real-time demographic impact of pandemic

Displaced populations in camps and temporary housing unable to implement public health measures
Reproductive health access disrupted — maternal mortality rising as healthcare systems diverted to pandemic response
